memory_candidates.content: In this repository's agent-system, a gate script's own in-line comment near a data structure (e.g. check-metalogic-cycles.sh's ALLOWLIST comment citing '8 lines') can go stale relative to the structure itself and relative to the script's own header comment, even when nothing is broken. When writing plan-authoring guidance that cites a gate's internal counts, prefer describing the mechanism (e.g. 'equality not containment', 'two named source constants') over a specific count, and re-verify any count against the live file rather than trusting a prior citation.

When a domain extension's plan-authoring guidance would otherwise restate a contract already documented in detail in the core extension (e.g. verify-deploy.sh's target-shape contract in core's plan-format.md sub-case (b)), the domain file should state the fact tersely with an explicit pointer to the core source, not re-derive the full contract -- avoids redundant/divergent documentation across extensions.
